description.narrative: Cap des Biches (CdB, the Plant) is an 86 MW Heavy Fuel Oil (HFO)-fired independent power producer (IPP) in Senegal. The Plant was developed and is owned by ContourGlobal (CG, or the Sponsor) and was built in two phases (CdB-I and II in 2015-2016), with the ability to convert to gas. IFC invested in both phases (please refer to Cap des Biches, project ID #35175 and #38792 respectively). The proposed investment includes a c. [105]m debt package to finance the capex to convert the plant from HFO to gas and refinance its outstanding debt (the Project).

In Senegal, end-user electricity tariffs are among the highest in West Africa, at around US$0.21/kWh equivalent, yet they remain below cost-recovery levels. The proposed conversion project will enable Senelec to substitute heavy fuel oil (HFO) with natural gassignificantly reducing fuel costs. As a result, the Plant will generate electricity at a lower cost than under its current configuration. At present, approximately 70% of electricity generation in Senegal relies on oil-based thermal sources. By displacing oil-based generation, the Project will materially reduce the electricity sectors greenhouse gas emissions. Beyond these direct cost and emissions benefits, the Project will also strengthen system resilience by supporting diversification of the generation mix away from oil as gas resources come onstream.
